name: External data sources
description: External data sources capabilities. Includes Create, Read, Update and Delete External data Sources., Disable CDC on an existing source, Draft a Custom REST source manifest from API documentation using an LLM, Enable CDC on an existing source, Fetch current schema/table list from the source and create any new ExternalDataSchema rows (no data sync)., List credentials the requesting user stored via the source connect page that haven't been consumed yet, List the accounts/properties a connected OAuth integration exposes, in the shared IntegrationAccount shape, Live CDC health for an existing source: slot/publication existence and WAL lag, and 12 more.
